    (m₁ \ m₂).size = m₁.size := by

    exact h a ha

  (Raw₀.Const.insertMany_ind ⟨m.1, _⟩ l ⟨m.2, init⟩
    (fun m a b ⟨h, h'⟩ => ⟨h.insert₀, insert ⟨m, h⟩ a b h'⟩) :
